mathematical_findings.inward_key_proof: For every processed client, either migrate once or permanently retain at its leaf. Maximum popped keys U=r(A-w)/q+w are nonincreasing. A migrating step gives C_new=C_old+w<U, new V=U, same-leaf old V_j=U+(w_j-w)>=U and other-leaf V unchanged. Thus all moved clients remain at center with C<V_j; no return processing exists or is needed. The invariant uses the latest processed key, not each client's old entry key.
mathematical_findings.outward_star: Center opens first, every light client originally at center, two occupied options per client, q_center>=q_leaf. Per-edge weights may differ arbitrarily. Descending-weight leaf queues and minimum eligible leaf price select each client once. Monotone center decrease/leaf increase makes skipping permanent, and descending edge weights plus nondecreasing selected leaf prices preclude return. No algorithm, proof, domain or time claim changed.
mathematical_findings.path: Each light client has exactly the endpoints of one consistently opening-directed path edge; each vertex indegree/outdegree<=1, q_tail>=q_head, all weights on each edge equal but may differ between edges. Any legal strictly forward one-time order is valid: equal edge weights reset every already moved client comparison together, predecessor additions and successor removals only help. The erratum adds no edgewise-unequal guarantee and changes no proof.
mathematical_findings.complete_game: Frozen heavy clients retain every original option, including across light components: (W_s-w_i)/q_s<=gamma<=W_t/q_t. Boxes constrain chosen witnesses, not legal actions. Each occupied station is split into its actual labeled facilities with independent uniform choice; self weight remains atomic. Full continuation uses BOX-TO-2 and already proved MAX, with current pools for surviving sources and all original pools when source disappears.
mathematical_findings.fc51: The done inward-star edge preserves its original accepted/unconditional ALL(INWARD-STAR, BOX-TO-2, MAX-import) contribution to FINITE-2. Its own endpoints/evidence do not use the changed early/path file. It allows unbounded leaf count and unbounded exact light-weight diversity on its directional two-option star domain. It does not solve arbitrary light menus.
mathematical_findings.fpt: ALL(type-support IP, same-frozen-set greedy box existence) proves whole FPT target f(c,d)poly(L), where c bounds stations and d distinct exact movable light weights per component. Types use exact weight plus complete occupied menu. Genuine greedy, positive gamma and component bounds are input promises; standard fixed-variable ILP is an already imported theorem, not a new open premise. Fixed (c,d) gives polynomial time; growing parameters do not.
mathematical_findings.incomparability: The inward-star n-leaf genuine greedy family G=n^3 has c=n+1 and d=n, so no fixed (c,d) slice contains its whole family. Conversely genuine greedy mixed chain clients (10,{H}),(1,{H,M}),(6,{M}),(1,{M,L}),(4,{L}), k=4, opens H11,M7,H11/2,L4, with gamma=4,q=(2,1,1),c=3,d=1, while M opens between its neighbors and fails the inward-star promise. These are domain distinctions, not unproved hypotheses.
mathematical_findings.chain_target: c=3 yields f(3,d)poly(L), at most 18d integer variables by the general bound, for every fixed d-bound and permits unequal weights on the same edge. Old path slice only requires each edge uniform, hence d<=2 for a three-station chain. Unbounded d still requires one uniform fixed P(L) independent of d; no star comparison edit closes it.
